completion:
Select the report according to the **module** (group of tests) and the installation **subsystem**.
3. In the **Individual Appendix** (Appendix 3.2 - Part P Fire Detection – and Appendix 3.3 - Smoke and Heat Detectors) the tests to be carried out on failed appliances are recorded with the **general observations regarding the declared state**, carried out in the report. This allows for comparison with the report, sometimes helping to identify the defect and the causes and/or mitigating factors. However, also note in these individual reports any other defects or anomalies observed, as in addition to those underlying the reported deficiency.
